examples.title: [Android] Fix SearchBar IME full-screen extract mode in landscape orientation
examples.author: SubhikshaSf4851
observations: Merged PR currently carries s/agent-fix-implemented and s/agent-suggestions-implemented.
Original commit sequence includes 'Updated suggestion' and 'committed the suggestion'.
examples.caveat: Evidence of uptake in one PR, not a representative satisfaction survey or independently measured quality uplift.

examples.title: [Android] Fix CollectionView ActivityIndicator not animating after header height change
examples.author: Vignesh-SF3580
examples.quote: I tested this locally, and it did not resolve the issue.
observations: The author reports that the AI's sync-first approach reproduces the original problem and that removing an attachment condition breaks recycled items.
The PR also currently carries agent-fix-win and implementation labels, illustrating why those labels cannot be treated as calibrated success scores.
examples.caveat: A reported ineffective suggestion, not proof of an AI-caused regression in a shipped release.

examples.title: [iOS] Fix VerticalOffset Update When Modifying CollectionView.ItemsSource While Scrolled
observations: This is the only PR returned by the current repository-wide s/agent-fix-lose label search.
The label description says the author adopted the agent's fix and it turned out to be bad.
The PR is merged and also carries s/agent-suggestions-implemented, but no s/agent-reviewed label at collection time.
examples.caveat: Sparse, mutable, incomplete negative labeling cannot establish an AI-attributable regression or failure rate.
